scope: Reconcile recent LibreDWG and ACadSharp spline, LEADER annotation, and INSERT/TABLE reports with local typed models, parser/writer routes, and focused tests; refine existing owners without asserting unverified peer behavior locally or promoting support.

method.kind: Primary-source web research plus targeted local source/test/plan inspection

evidence.topic: LibreDWG HATCH spline and SAT-block fixes are route-specific peer evidence
evidence.observed: LibreDWG 0.14.1 NEWS lists a rational HATCH spline knots-versus-weights correction and a separate 3DSOLID/REGION DXF export off-by-one that dropped the last SAT block.
evidence.localObservation: The plan already assigns HATCH boundary weight handling to PAR-30/7N and standalone SPLINE semantics to PAR-22/7H/7I/7AB. Existing tests retain distinct knot and weight vectors; the standalone spline route has an independent analytic point control.
evidence.disposition: Do not transfer HATCH group-42 or HATCH-specific omission rules to standalone SPLINE group 41. Keep exact arrays and analytic curve checks in each owning grammar. No local defect is established by the peer release note.

evidence.observed: The v3.8.0 reporter says an AutoCAD DWG converted to DXF fails a GDAL GeoJSON conversion and links a ZIP with source DWG and emitted DXF. The issue text gives no offending entity handle, knot/weight/control arrays, independently expected curve, or exact GDAL diagnostic; its AI-chat link is not evidence.
evidence.localObservation: The peer artifact is linked but was not acquired. Existing PAR-22/7H/7I/7AB already require exact source/emitted arrays and an independently evaluated curve point, with GDAL as optional downstream projection only.
evidence.disposition: Keep this as a peer scenario lead under existing owners. If acquired later, hash and inspect only in scratch and bind all outputs to the exact input/version/tool options. Do not make the fast implementation loop wait for it or infer a format rule from the GeoJSON failure.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp #1180 LEADER metrics and local annotation-edge gap
evidence.observed: The peer report claims 19 annotated LEADERs among 23 had group-41 width zero in ACadSharp 3.6.51 DWG reads while reference conversions reportedly emitted positive widths. Autodesk documents group 40/41 as text annotation height/width and 340 as a hard reference to an MTEXT, TOLERANCE, or INSERT.
evidence.localObservation: Local DXF parse retains 40/41/340, DXF output maps a known annotation source handle to its minted handle, and DWG read captures metrics. The generated AC1015/1018/1021 local DWG metric test sets non-default height/width and a following TOLERANCE but has no associated annotation. `DRW_Leader::encodeDwg` currently writes a null AnnotH.
evidence.disposition: Keep the metric regression separate from full annotation-graph support. Add a focused DXF ASCII/binary group-340 identity/owner round-trip under PAR-20/7F/7AY. Before changing DWG layout, read ODA §20.4.47 and use a producer-backed sample; implement real reference closure or refuse non-null associations before publication. Never silently null the source association or derive expected metrics from fonts without independent evidence.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp #1172 INSERT counts can conflate ACAD_TABLE
evidence.observed: The open report describes AC1032 INSERT inventory counts dropping from 9 to 3 and 14 to 13 through a peer read/write/read route, with no public source files. A commenter notes `TableEntity : Insert` and links a separate #1001 DXF writer omission report; that report's notification behavior differs from #1172's stated no-notification symptom, so it is not a full explanation.
evidence.localObservation: Local `DRW_Table` also derives from `DRW_Insert`; aggregate base-class counts can conflate table and ordinary insert entities. Existing PAR-126/7G.3d tests retain the table's own typed identity and reference graph.
evidence.disposition: Stratify inventories by exact entity type/DXF name, handle, owner/BLOCK_RECORD path, and callback/diagnostic status. Count ordinary INSERT and ACAD_TABLE separately; census ATTRIB/SEQEND children independently. Keep locally generated DXF controls distinct from AC1032 DWG qualification and do not treat peer counts as proof of the root cause.

planImpact.fastNextAction: Add an ASCII/binary DXF LEADER group-340 identity and suffix-preservation control under the existing DXF fixture target; keep DWG annotation-reference encoding behind ODA/spec and producer-sample review.
planImpact.qualificationBoundary: Peer reports/releases are leads, not local reproductions or normative rules. Parser fields, graph closure, curve semantics, consumer projection, and native acceptance remain separate claims.
